camera.why: side shows shin vertical at the top, posterior pelvic tilt and torso parallel to floor

start_pose.description: Seated on the floor, upper back resting on the bench edge, hips low near floor, feet flat, barbell over hip crease held with both hands
start_pose.implement: barbell on hip crease, hands on bar

phases.name: thrust
phases.description: Drive through heels, lift hips until torso is parallel to the floor, shins vertical, posterior pelvic tilt, ribs down, chin tucked
phases.implement_path: barbell travels straight up from hip crease to hip height (~35-45 cm rise)
phases.notes: knees ~90 deg and shins vertical at lockout; hips in line with torso and thighs

phases.name: top_hold
phases.description: Squeeze glutes at the top for 1 s

phases.name: lower
phases.description: Lower hips straight down with control until buttocks are an inch off the floor, back stays on bench

mistakes.mistake: Overarching the lower back at the top
mistakes.visual: ribs flare, lumbar hyperextension, hips pushed beyond torso line
mistakes.fix: tuck chin and pelvis, ribs down

mistakes.visual: feet far from glutes: shin leans out, hamstrings burn; too close: knees push forward, quads take over
mistakes.fix: adjust feet so shins are vertical at top

mistakes.mistake: Bar slides / hips don't lock out
mistakes.visual: hips stop below torso-line, torso incline at top

specs.safety: Use a bar pad and secure bench against a wall; keep neck neutral; don't hyperextend; ramp load gradually.
specs.progression: Single-leg hip thrust, banded hip thrust, heavy barbell

specs.equipment_setup: Kettlebell about 30-45 cm in front of the feet, feet shoulder width, toes slightly out; hike the bell back between the legs with both hands (double overhand grip)

camera.why: side shows hinge, bell arc and hip snap; front shows symmetry

start_pose.description: Hinged setup, bell hiked back between thighs, arms straight against the inner thighs, back flat, chest up
start_pose.implement: kettlebell hiked behind knees, handle at height of knee/upper thigh

phases.name: hip_drive
phases.description: Explosively extend hips and knees (snap), squeeze glutes, arms just guide the bell forward; trunk stands tall
phases.implement_path: bell arcs forward and upward to chest height (arms ~parallel to floor), moving from momentum not arms
phases.notes: arms ~85 deg shoulder flexion at the top; do not lean back

phases.name: float
phases.description: Bell floats weightless at the top for an instant, torso vertical, glutes squeezed
phases.implement_path: bell at apex at chest height

phases.name: backswing
phases.description: Bell falls; as arms come to the abdomen hinge hips back and let the bell travel between the thighs, torso leans forward ~60 deg, shins nearly vertical
phases.implement_path: bell swings back between the thighs above knee height, forearms against inner thighs
phases.notes: this is a hinge, not a squat; back stays flat

specs.rep_loop: hip_drive -> float -> backswing (continuous loop; rep starts at the hiked position)

mistakes.visual: knees bend deeply (>70 deg) and hips drop low, torso upright
mistakes.fix: push hips back; keep shins near vertical

mistakes.visual: arms pull and shoulders shrug, bell rises above chest height with leaning back
mistakes.fix: snap hips; arms relaxed; bell to chest height

mistakes.visual: spine rounds as bell drops between legs, head drops
mistakes.fix: chest up, hinge deeper at hips, neutral spine

specs.safety: Learn the hip hinge first; keep neutral spine; use a weight you can control; clear the area; don't let the bell pull your shoulders forward.
specs.regression: Kettlebell deadlift, hip hinge drills, light weight swing
specs.progression: Heavier swings, single-arm swing, American/overhead swing

specs.equipment_setup: Two heavy dumbbells on the floor at the sides of the feet; pick up with a hip hinge, flat back; hold at sides with a firm grip

camera.why: front 3q shows level shoulders and no sway; side shows upright posture and short steps

start_pose.description: Standing tall holding a heavy dumbbell in each hand at the sides, shoulders back and down, chest up, core braced, neck neutral
start_pose.implement: dumbbells hang by the sides of thighs, 5-10 cm from legs

phases.name: pickup
phases.description: Hinge hips back, flat back, grip the weights, drive up to standing tall (deadlift-like)
phases.implement_path: dumbbells rise from floor to hanging at sides
phases.notes: from hinged setup (trunk ~55, knee ~50) to tall

phases.name: walk
phases.description: Take short, quick steps (step length ~0.5-0.6 m) with upright posture, shoulders level, weights hang without swinging, core braced
contacts: one foot on floor at a time (alternating)
phases.implement_path: dumbbells hang by sides, minimal swing; walking forward ~1.0-1.4 m/s
phases.notes: values are a heel-strike snapshot of the lead leg (hip flexion 22); trailing leg hip extension -10, knee 5; repeat alternating

phases.name: set_down
phases.description: Stop, hinge hips back and lower the dumbbells to the floor under control, flat back
phases.implement_path: dumbbells lower to floor beside feet

specs.tempo_default: 0.55 s per step (about 110 steps/min), 20-40 s per set

mistakes.visual: torso inclines >10 deg and head juts forward
mistakes.fix: chest up, ribs stacked over hips, gaze forward

mistakes.visual: shoulders rise toward ears with weights pulling them down
mistakes.fix: pull shoulder blades down and back

mistakes.visual: dumbbells swing and steps too long, trunk sways

specs.safety: Use a weight you can hold with a firm grip; keep spine neutral; clear the walkway; set down with control, not a drop.
specs.regression: Lighter dumbbells, shorter distance, single dumbbell suitcase carry
specs.progression: Heavier farmer handles, trap-bar carries, fat grips

specs.equipment_setup: One dumbbell held in one hand at the side, arm straight, like a suitcase; other hand free (on hip or hanging); feet hip width

camera.why: front shows resisting lateral lean and level shoulders/pelvis; side shows knee lift and upright posture

start_pose.description: Standing tall, weight in one hand, shoulders and pelvis level, torso vertical (no lean toward the weight), core braced
start_pose.implement: dumbbell hangs at the side of the thigh, arm straight

phases.name: knee_lift
phases.description: March in place: lift one knee until the thigh is ~parallel to the floor, standing leg stays straight, torso stays vertical, no side lean
phases.implement_path: dumbbell hangs still beside the thigh, no swing
phases.notes: free leg: hip 90, knee 90; pelvis level; shoulder not hiked

phases.name: knee_lower
phases.description: Lower the foot under control and immediately lift the opposite knee
contacts: both feet flat for a moment
phases.notes: alternate legs

specs.rep_loop: knee_lift (left) -> knee_lower -> knee_lift (right) -> knee_lower (alternating for 30-45 s, then switch hand)

mistakes.visual: torso tilts toward the loaded side, hip hikes on the other side
mistakes.fix: stack ribs over hips, lighter weight

mistakes.visual: hip pushes sideways, shoulder hikes
dumbbell swings and steps fast

specs.safety: Choose a weight you can hold stable; keep knees and spine neutral; stop if lower back strains.
specs.progression: Heavier weight, walking suitcase carry, offset farmer carry

specs.equipment_setup: Sled loaded with plates on turf; hands gripping upper handles (high-handle grip), arms nearly straight; feet behind, torso inclined

camera.why: side shows body lean line from heel to head, arm extension and short strides

start_pose.description: Leaning forward at ~45 deg with a straight line from heels to head, hands on high handles, arms straight, rear foot behind
contacts: both feet on floor (rear on ball of foot)
start_pose.implement: sled handles at about chest/shoulder height, sled stationary

phases.name: drive_step
phases.description: Drive the stance leg to full extension with each step (ankle/knee/hip), swing the other knee forward with short quick steps; arms stay locked, shoulders anchored in handles
contacts: one foot driving on ball of the foot (alternating)
phases.implement_path: sled slides forward at a steady ~1 m/s; hands do not push, shoulders anchor
phases.notes: stance leg: knee ~15, ankle plantarflexed during toe-off; swing leg: hip 70, knee 90; torso line stays constant; step length ~0.5 m

phases.name: repeat_step
phases.description: Alternate legs with the same stiff torso line and short strides
phases.notes: mirrored leg roles compared to drive_step

specs.rep_loop: drive_step -> repeat_step (cycle for 10-30 m, then rest)

mistakes.visual: torso <25 deg lean, sled pushes up not forward
mistakes.fix: lean into the sled at ~45 deg

mistakes.visual: spine rounds, head cranes up
overstriding with elbows bending and shoulders shrugging

specs.safety: Pick a load that allows good posture; keep neutral spine; warm up; use turf or smooth floor; don't let the sled run into you.
specs.regression: Lighter sled load or high-handle at lower speed, walking pushes
specs.progression: Heavier loads, low-handle grip, sprint pushes

specs.equipment_setup: Lie prone on the bench, knees just off the edge aligned with the machine axis, roller pad on lower calves just above the heels, hands on handles, hips pressed down

camera.why: side shows knee flexion range and hips staying down; back view shows heel/pad symmetry

start_pose.description: Prone on the bench, legs nearly straight (knee ~5 deg), pad on lower calves, chest and hips on bench, grip handles
contacts: torso, hips and thighs on bench
start_pose.implement: pad at lower calf just above the heels

phases.name: curl
phases.description: Curl heels toward the buttocks by flexing the knees, hips stay pressed down, pad rises on an arc
phases.implement_path: pad travels in an arc up toward the buttocks, stopping before touching
phases.notes: ankles slightly dorsiflexed; top ~100-110 deg knee flexion

phases.name: peak_pause
phases.description: Squeeze hamstrings at the top for a beat

phases.name: lower
phases.description: Lower under control to near full extension, keep tension, don't let the stack slam
phases.implement_path: pad returns along the same arc
phases.notes: stop just short of full lock

mistakes.visual: pelvis rises and lower back arches during curl
mistakes.fix: lower the weight, keep hips pressed

mistakes.visual: legs snap up and drop quickly
knees only bend ~45 deg then stop

specs.safety: Align knee axis with the machine pivot; use a controlled load; stop if there is cramping or hamstring pain; avoid hyperextending knees at the bottom.
specs.progression: Slow eccentric, single-leg curl, Nordic curl

variants.difference: app's generic leg curl is the prone/lying machine version; if the gym machine is seated, the knee motion is the same but the body is seated

specs.equipment_setup: Anchor the band at floor level behind the feet (door/leg of a heavy object); loop the band around both ankles; lie prone with forehead on stacked hands; band has slight tension at start

start_pose.description: Prone on a mat, legs straight with band around ankles, hips flat, forehead on hands

start_pose.implement: band from anchor behind feet to ankles, taut at start

phases.name: curl
phases.description: Bend the knees and bring heels toward the buttocks against the band's resistance, hips stay flat on mat
phases.implement_path: band stretches along the line toward the anchor, heels move in an arc
phases.notes: stop before the lower back arches

phases.name: peak_pause
phases.description: Squeeze the hamstrings for 1 s

phases.name: lower
phases.description: Slowly straighten the legs, keep tension
phases.notes: do not let band snap

mistakes.visual: pelvis rises and lower back extends as band pulls
mistakes.fix: tuck pelvis, shorten range or lighter band

mistakes.visual: legs drop fast
knees bend ~30 deg and stop

specs.safety: Anchor must be secure; check band for tears; keep neck neutral; stop with cramping.
specs.progression: Heavier band, single-leg curl, Nordic curl

specs.equipment_setup: Seat adjusted so the knee aligns with the machine pivot; back pad supports the lower back; ankle pad sits on the lower shin just above the ankles; hands on side handles

camera.why: side shows knee extension arc and back against pad; front shows leg/foot alignment

start_pose.description: Seated upright (back reclined ~10 deg), thighs on seat, knees at 90 deg, shins vertical, pad on lower shin

phases.name: extend

phases.implement_path: pad travels from shins vertical to nearly horizontal in an arc
phases.notes: stop short of hard lockout (~5 deg)

phases.name: peak_pause
phases.description: Squeeze at the top for 1 s

phases.name: lower

mistakes.mistake: Hips lift off the seat / swinging
mistakes.visual: buttocks rise and torso rocks to throw the weight up
mistakes.fix: lower the load, hold the handles

mistakes.visual: knee snaps to full lock at top
legs fall quickly

specs.safety: Align knee axis with machine pivot; avoid heavy loads if you have kneecap pain; control the eccentric.
specs.regression: Short range of motion, lighter load
specs.progression: Single-leg extension, slow eccentric, pause

specs.equipment_setup: Balls of both feet on the edge of a step/platform with heels hanging off, feet hip width and parallel; hand on wall/rail for balance
